spec2def(avicap32.dll avicap32.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

include_directories(BEFORE ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/wine)

# avicap32.dll is all Rust (avicap32-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/avicap32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# avicap32.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/avicap32-rust/src/avicap32/avicap32.rs)
add_cargo_module(avicap32 avicap32-cargo avicap32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE avicap32-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
